instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.

arguments.note: I will turn the left wrist downward to inspect the charger and plan a grasp that leaves its pins clear.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The charger lies flat with its pins pointing toward the front. I am approaching its body from above, keeping the pins outside the grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The downward view shows the charger ahead of the open jaws. I am centering over its body and lowering to a pre-grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger body is between the jaws but slightly to the right. I am correcting laterally and lowering while leaving its front pins free.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The head view shows the grasp point still behind the charger. I am moving toward the front at a safe height to align over the actual body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view now places the charger ahead and left of the grasp centre. I am making a measured centering correction before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is centered in the downward view. I am lowering ten millimetres to bring the jaw pads alongside its body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are aligned with the charger body and clear of its pins. I will lower five millimetres and close gently around the body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gripper has closed against the charger body. I will lift it clear of the table before rotating its pins downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger lifted securely. I will rotate it in stages so its pins point downward and its pin pair follows the power strip’s angle.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger remains secure during rotation. I will finish turning its pins vertically downward before moving over a socket.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The full rotation was refused without movement. I will use a smaller intermediate rotation to keep the wrist configuration reachable.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will carry the charger above the middle socket while keeping its pins well clear of the strip. This forward position also gives the wrist more room to finish rotating.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is now safely above the strip. I will finish the final twenty degrees of rotation so the pins are upright for insertion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 22 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The held charger blocks the working wrist’s view of the sockets. I will bring the idle wrist closer to obtain an independent alignment view.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 32 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The viewing arm completed only part of its approach. I will continue toward the strip while remaining above the working arm.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The idle wrist is above the work area. I will tilt its camera downward to see the pin-to-socket alignment.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The requested viewing tilt was unreachable. I will try a smaller tilt from the measured pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 37 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The strip is still at the lower edge of the viewing camera. I will shift the idle wrist toward the front and continue tilting downward.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The viewing pose exceeded the wrist’s reachable configuration. I will bring the idle arm closer to its base before tilting further.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger appears at the left edge of the idle camera. I will angle that camera down and left to bring the insertion area into view.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The independent view confirms the charger is upright above the strip. I will lower toward the socket while retaining clearance for final alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The last motion landed lower and tilted more than requested, so I will lift and restore upright alignment before attempting contact.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The upright correction was unreachable. I will first lift vertically from the strip to create room for a safer realignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The near-side wrist configuration cannot reach the insertion height upright. I will raise the charger to turn the wrist around and approach from the opposite side.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the charger clear of the strip, I will begin turning the wrist around while restoring vertical pins.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 29 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The charger remains secure and clear of obstacles. I will continue the staged turn toward the opposite-side insertion approach.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The opposite-side turn is unreachable. I will restore the socket angle and instead use the farther socket, which provides more extension for the arm.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 25 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will position above the farther socket, keeping the pins clear while checking whether this more extended pose reaches correctly.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist is again near its rotation limit. I will make a small tilt adjustment at clearance height before bringing the pins toward the socket.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.hindsight: A grasp nearer the charger's upper end, or an earlier handoff to the other arm, would provide more clearance for upright insertion. I also spent too many steps obtaining the independent camera view.
arguments.reason: I could not reach the socket at insertion height with the charger upright; the wrist repeatedly reached its joint limit. The charger remains held clear of the strip.

calls.tool_result: Acknowledged give_up.

arguments.hindsight: A grasp nearer the charger's upper end, or an earlier handoff to the other arm, would provide more clearance for upright insertion. I also spent too many steps obtaining the independent camera view.
arguments.reason: I could not reach the socket at insertion height with the charger upright; the wrist repeatedly reached its joint limit. The charger remains held clear of the strip.
